purpose: Record the doctor command family dry-run extraction proof before any physical package split.
policy: The doctor family may only move after JSON golden checks, nextActions coverage, support bundle contract coverage, stdout/stderr discipline, and rollback evidence pass from the current single-package layout.

relatedSharedContracts.reason: doctor nextActions point users to bug support bundles, so doctor extraction must preserve bug --json support bundle fields and redaction guidance.
doctor --json currently writes through shared JSON helpers and must preserve stdout-only JSON output after extraction.

dryRunFindings.finding: doctorCommand still writes JSON through package-level printJSON and shared IO helpers, so physical extraction should introduce a small JSON/output adapter.
doctor nextActions intentionally reference bug --json support bundles; dry-run tests pin supportBundle schema, redaction, commands, and nextActions before any package movement.
doctorNextActions is covered for fail, warn, and healthy paths so remediation guidance remains stable during future extraction.

physicalSplitAdmission.nextAllowedAction: Move the doctor family only in a dedicated commit after introducing JSON/output adapters and preserving support bundle contracts.
physicalSplitAdmission.rollbackRequirement: Restore doctor.go, doctor_checks.go, and doctor_test.go to cmd/gofly/internal/command in one commit if diagnostics, JSON fields, stdout/stderr discipline, support bundle references, or nextActions regress.
